result.brief: 研究世界动作模型中视觉表征经K/V路由进入动作生成的机制，提出Tail-AV探针与PASA-KV攻击，揭示表征扰动幅度与闭环脆弱性不匹配。
result.reason: Analyzes how internal visual/world representations are read out into action generation in world action models, contributing a representation-to-action routing view relevant to world-model representation learning.
